## Change

Describe the user problem and link the relevant issue.

## Implementation

Explain the approach, tradeoffs, owned DOM mutations and undo behaviour.

## Verification

- [ ] Types, lint, unit tests and build pass (`npm run check`).
- [ ] Formatting passes (`npm run format:check`).
- [ ] Relevant fixture integration tests pass (`npm run test:e2e`).
- [ ] Changed behaviour was checked on the real site, or the missing check is explicitly documented.
- [ ] Privacy, permissions, unknown/classic-layout no-op and disable/undo behaviour are preserved.
- [ ] Changelog, test evidence and affected documentation are updated.
- [ ] No account data, tokens, unsanitised captures or unrelated generated files are included.

## Remaining checks

Distinguish automated fixture results, temporary live code testing and installed-build validation.
